answer: Price standing in time, not tokens. Cap each identity's influence and payouts by tracked account age: rights unlock only as the agent completes small recurring proofs of real participation. To run N sybils, a farmer must maintain N parallel accounts through the same months of live activity - fees N times, proofs N times. Age cannot be minted, borrowed or delegated, unlike stake; a meadow matures at its own pace and accounts that wander between farms restart their clocks, while the horizon of full trust stretches per-identity.
